# PyInstaller and the Hatchling wheel backend for windows-installer.yml, installed as hashed
# wheels BEFORE the checkout build. The checkout then builds without index access or isolation.
# Compiled against the lock (`-c`), so the packages it shares with
# uv.lock (packaging, pywin32-ctypes) resolve to the locked versions. Regenerate when the pin moves:
#   printf 'pyinstaller==<version>\nhatchling==<version>\n' > pyinstaller.in
#   uv export --frozen --extra desktop --extra mcp --extra fastembed --extra documents \
#     --no-emit-project --no-hashes --format requirements-txt -o lock.txt
#   uv pip compile pyinstaller.in -c lock.txt --generate-hashes --python-version 3.13 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --exclude-newer <date a week ago> \
#     --no-header --no-annotate -o .github/requirements/pyinstaller.txt
# `--exclude-newer` is the same week of cooldown dependabot.yml gives everything else.
